people.name: Pilate
people.line: Roman governor who presided over Jesus' trial

translations.web: Pilate said to them, “Why, what evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, “Crucify him!”
translations.bsb: “Why?” asked Pilate. “What evil has He done?” But they shouted all the louder, “Crucify Him!”
translations.kjv: Then Pilate said unto them, Why, what evil hath he done? And they cried out the more exceedingly, Crucify him.
